description: Manage unfinished local Codex / ChatGPT Work tasks, monitor quota without model calls, and continue eligible chats after a native recovery check.

interface.shortDescription: 1.0 · Continue unfinished tasks after quota resets
interface.longDescription:
Open Settings → Management → Manage Codex Task Resume, or the global Codex Task Resume · Manage entry. Configure the threshold, reset delay, exact multiline prompt and target scope once. Settings and chat selection do not call the model.

Monitoring: while the native MCP service is connected, a local worker periodically reads quota without inference, sharing a throttle with trusted task hooks. The panel shows the actual five-hour reset time, planned check, selected targets, queued candidates, last successful check and recent task events. An ended turn does not prove that the task is complete.

Scheduling requirement: a native recovery check must be created through a model turn, preferably while quota remains available. Saving settings or selecting targets does not create it. If quota is exhausted before scheduling, an automatic wake is not guaranteed. The full real exhaustion → reset → wake → send cycle remains unverified.

Recovery: after the actual reset plus saved delay, recheck quota, native desktop state and recent context. Send the exact saved prompt only to eligible stopped, unfinished local root chats. Skip running, completed, paused, blocked, archived, controller and ambiguous chats. Never automatically retry uncertain sends.

Defaults: strictly below 2%, wait 2 minutes, saved prompt 继续任务, minimum check interval 60 seconds. Existing custom settings take precedence. Updates preserve controller ownership, selections, queues and send records. Installation does not enable monitoring or grant hook trust.

Language: the panel, launcher and help automatically follow the Windows display language; Chinese variants use Simplified Chinese and other languages use English. Saved prompts, chat titles and project paths are never translated. Plugin detail text follows the display language at installation.

Windows local Codex / ChatGPT Work only. Ordinary ChatGPT web, cloud tasks, remote hosts and subagents are excluded. The native client, service and device must remain available; sleep, disconnection or exhausted quota can delay execution. Recovery and continued work use normal quota.

Install locally: extract the release, fully exit the client, run install.cmd and reopen. Do not upload this ZIP into the Create Plugin dialog. Version 1.0 (manifest 1.0.0), author 果果. Project: https://github.com/mango6i/codex-task-resume
defaultPrompt: Use $quota-resume to open the settings dialog.
Use $quota-resume to initialize settings, preserve my saved values and leave continuation disabled.
Use $quota-resume to stop monitoring and automatic continuation.
